vo: Ask three AIs the same question and you get three different winners.
Best project management tool? ChatGPT says Asana, Gemini says Monday, and Google says ClickUp.
Email marketing? Omnisend, ActiveCampaign and Mailchimp, one winner each.
In our data, all three agree on the number one brand only about a third of the time.
So winning one AI isn't enough. Check every engine with SupaIntent.
